tools.name: trustpilot_reviews
tools.description: Fetch verified Trustpilot customer reviews for any company domain (e.g. "printful.com" or "shopify.com"), complete with 1–5 star distribution histogram, aspect sentiment polarities, reviewer country/verification level, and company replies. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned (0 Credits if empty).

tools.name: trustpilot_company
tools.description: Retrieve a company TrustScore, star rating, total verified reviews, 12-month review velocity, claimed/verified status, categories, and business contact info on Trustpilot. Cost: 10 Credits / company profile.

tools.name: yelp_search
tools.description: Search Yelp local businesses by keyword and city/location (e.g. query="coffee", location="Austin, TX") and retrieve Yelp business_id, alias, unrounded star rating, review count, price level, phone, address, and coordinates. Cost: 5 Credits / business returned.

tools.name: yelp_reviews
tools.description: Retrieve full-text Yelp customer reviews, star distribution, sentiment polarity breakdown, useful/funny/cool votes, and owner replies by Yelp business_id, alias, or yelp.com/biz URL (bypasses the official Yelp Fusion 3-review cap). Cost: 2 Credits / review returned.

tools.name: tripadvisor_search
tools.description: Search TripAdvisor destinations, cities, hotels, attractions, and restaurants by query (e.g. "Paris" or "Santorini hotels") to obtain geo_id / location_id, ratings, review counts, and coordinates. Cost: 5 Credits / location returned.

tools.name: tripadvisor_restaurants
tools.description: Retrieve ranked TripAdvisor restaurants for a destination geo_id (e.g. "187147" for Paris), including bubble rating, total reviews, popularity rank, price range, cuisines, neighborhood, and Travellers Choice badges. Cost: 5 Credits / restaurant returned.

tools.name: google_play_reviews
tools.description: Fetch real-time Google Play Store customer reviews for any Android app package ID (e.g. "com.spotify.music" or "com.openai.chatgpt"), including star histogram, aspect sentiment polarities, app_version, thumbs-up votes, and developer replies. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned.

tools.name: app_store_reviews
tools.description: Fetch real-time Apple App Store customer reviews for any iOS/macOS app numeric ID (e.g. "324684580" for Spotify or "6448311069" for ChatGPT) across 175+ countries, including star distribution, sentiment polarity, app_version, and helpfulness votes. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned.
